assessments.reasoning: The publisher returned 3,393 UTF-8 bytes from LICENSE at the exact ngrep commit 351ac491358f89a7860bbbe9963cb4bc7d60000f. The acquisition-reported whole-file SHA-256 matches the claim's scope digest. Bytes [0,1840) run from Jordan Ritter's 2017 attribution through the final disclaimer and its terminating LF. The remainder introduces tcpkill from dsniff and contains a distinct Dug Song attribution and terms, including similar disclaimer language. This binding establishes the publisher passage and its boundary at the cited commit. [Pinned ngrep LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpr5/ngrep/351ac491358f89a7860bbbe9963cb4bc7d60000f/LICENSE)

The 8,703-byte JSON record at SPDX data commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 identifies the entry as ngrep, named ngrep License. The decoded licenseText is 1,840 bytes and equals the full publisher prefix, including whitespace and the final LF. The cross-reference carries match="false" for the master LICENSE URL. That adverse metadata applies to a mutable reference, while the byte comparison uses a specific commit and bounded passage. This binding establishes the identifier and decoded representation at the pinned SPDX revision. [Pinned SPDX detail record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/ngrep.json)

The complete standalone ngrep.txt at SPDX data commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 is 1,840 bytes, including 38 LFs. Every byte equals the corresponding byte in the publisher prefix and the decoded detail field. The standalone file ends at the LF after the Ritter disclaimer. This binding establishes the standalone representation at the pinned SPDX revision. [Pinned SPDX standalone text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/ngrep.txt)

The reopened GitHub tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b is annotated v3.29.0 and names a target of type commit with SHA 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. That SHA matches both the detail and standalone source URL revisions. GitHub reports the object as unsigned. This binding establishes the SPDX release-to-data-commit link. [SPDX annotated release tag](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Opened each named source once, sequentially, using fixed_public_source/open_original_source. Parsed the SPDX detail JSON and tag object, counted UTF-8 bytes including LF, and compared the decoded licenseText and standalone text against publisher bytes [0,1840) without normalization. Inspected the publisher bytes after that boundary, checked the SPDX identifier and cross-reference, and compared the annotated tag target with both SPDX source URL revisions.
challenge.results: All three compared passages are identical at 1,840 UTF-8 bytes, including 38 LF bytes and the final LF after the disclaimer. The publisher file continues for 1,553 bytes, starting with three additional LFs at offsets 1840–1842 and the tcpkill attribution at offset 1843. The SPDX detail reports crossRef.match as the string "false" for the mutable master LICENSE URL. The freshly opened annotated tag is unsigned and names the exact commit used by both pinned SPDX sources.

limitations: The correspondence covers the Jordan Ritter passage. The subsequent Dug Song notice remains outside the compared bytes.
Version 3.29.0 identifies the SPDX License List release. The claim identifies the ngrep source by commit and asserts no ngrep release number.
Legal equivalence, rights for other works, reuse, and installation require separate evidence.

The policy commit, bundle digest, and claim-record digest were supplied identifiers. The permitted original-source calls covered only the four named bindings. Source digest checks relied on the acquisition metadata.
reasoning: The ngrep publisher file establishes the bounded notice and the adjacent Dug Song material. Both SPDX files independently supply the same bounded representation at the cited data revision, and the annotated tag directly ties that revision to SPDX 3.29.0. Together the four bindings support the exact descriptive claim.
